## ChangeIP 3.2.3

This release prevents a network-manager reset from permanently shortening a
saved address pool. The complete desired pool is reapplied after manager start
or restart, and ChangeIP refuses to overwrite persistence while saved static
addresses are missing from runtime.

Persistence migration now runs through the newly installed binary after a
built-in update. When upgrading from ChangeIP 3.2.1 or older, use the verified
`update.sh` installer. If the old built-in updater was already used, run
`sudo change-ip migrate-persistence` once afterward.

The release includes regression coverage for a 30-address `/32` pool and an
isolated real-systemd lifecycle test covering delayed readiness, restart,
stop/start and idempotent reapplication.
